notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Update 1.0.4 is here, with a mix of bug fixes and small improvements to make your experience smoother as always.

General

 Added new Throwing mechanic (hold the throw button to launch an item or monster farther).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/eeebf0311092a9fc35d96a167b0411e907371403.gif
 Added new opportunities to gain reputation experience points when completing missions, hatching a monster, winning a race or a battle dance, giving a monster up for adoption, and gaining gacha.
 Increased the rate of new customer arrivals in late game.

Fixed Issues

 Fixed an issue with players holding items over their heads while crouching in multiplayer.
 Fixed hat issues for the Vespera Monster.
 Fixed Door Furniture not reverting to its normal material color in multiplayer.
 Fixed broken Monster Happiness missions that were unlocking before the monster was actually happy.
 Added a security message when attempting (and failing) to join a multiplayer session with players using a different version of Monster Care Simulator.
 Several other issues have been addressed to improve the gameplay experience.


✨ Hey…
If you had fun playing, dropping us a little review on Steam would help a ton, and seriously brighten our day. 💖

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/a517abfcb50a8e7004c31cb61dc307b2ad029c06.png

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’ve just rolled out update 1.0.3, which includes a mix of bug fixes and small improvements to make your experience smoother.

General

 Added new shelves that can be placed on walls to hold elements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/45e947366b43e86c215c8237e6c7bcbd9e6c5ace.png
 Added a shiny indicator in the My Monster tab and PC to show if a monster you own is shiny.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/d5242c4f30abe82a225751b91886c2885e56d114.png
 Monster names requested by customers are now highlighted above their heads to make them easier to find.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/b3e7a29f157bc2eac28328f9804ce10d20f0a9af.png
 Added more animations for players in multiplayer when petting or treating monsters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/feda93fa6587ab1b34fd0d8dcf64d17a4a35bdda.png
 General gamepad improvements.
 Running now uses a toggle on gamepad.
 Added hidden achievements.
 Added button animations for the Welcome Desk, Hatcher, and Knock Out Stations.


Fixed Issues

 Fixed issue where furnitures would fuse with other elements placed on top of them.
 Fixed Center capacity not upgrading correctly in multiplayer.
 Fixed monsters not looking at the player while being petted.
 Fixed Hatcher showing incorrect messages for players when an egg is ready to hatch.
 Fixed Hatcher not being able to be placed back in cardboard boxes.
 Fixed waypoint incorrectly indicating the Welcome Desk button during the tutorial.
 Fixed longer monster names sometimes being unreadable in-game and in the Monster PC.
 Fixed items disappearing when collecting/releasing rapidly.
 Fixed items sometimes colliding with a player when thrown in multiplayer.
 Fixed wall furniture being placeable while colliding with other furniture.
 Fixed hat position for Gorim.
 Fixed petting/treatment collision issues with certain monsters.
 Fixed furniture not updating color for other players when being lifted in multiplayer.
 Fixed footprints not appearing in all areas of the Center.
 Several other issues have been addressed to improve the gameplay experience.


💌 Psst
As always If you enjoyed the game, please consider leaving us a review on Steam, it really helps us a lot and means the world to our small team. 
Thank you! 🙏

Hi everyone!

We’ve just rolled out Patch 1.0.2, which includes a mix of bug fixes and small improvements to make your experience smoother. Check out the details below:

Changelog:


 Enabled street lights that automatically turn on at 7pm

 Fixed an issue where Monsters wouldn’t play with other players in multiplayer mode

notes.title: Update 0.6 – Care, Treatments & Missions
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We’re thrilled to bring you Update 0.6, packed with new healing mechanics, status effects, and mission features to make your time in the monster care center even more engaging!

🧬 New Status Effect: Poisoned!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/88bd436cbf7ec544074a8c67aa0fcbd7deda5d42.gif

Poisoned monsters are here!
You’ll now be able to treat this condition through a brand-new interactive mini-game using antivenom. Hold to extract poison, watch it move across the monster’s body, and enjoy satisfying feedback like changing facial expressions and custom particles.

🧼 Expanded Treatment System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/94673bcafa0c800add26ea6c4f4030a53274d622.gif

All treatment types: Dirt, Injury, Fire, Ice, and Poison — now include multiple levels of complexity, each with unique tools, sequences, and visual feedback.
Your center will now face everything from sticky tar to monsters frozen in giant ice blocks!

📋 New Mission System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/faebdb19473e2b8ff48212a3feb9d9b92e4a806e.png
To add more structure to your sessions, we’ve introduced a mission system:

 Clients may now request specific tasks during analysis.
 You can track and manage missions from the tablet.
 Switch between active missions, or decline them if you're already busy!

Missions include various goals, improving monster happiness, customizing appearances, completing healing tasks, or treadmill distance challenges.

📱 New Tablet Tab: Monster in care
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/7f4c0eb20105b5fbcae8900c7faab7d4a25ec5e9.png
A brand new "Monsters" tab has been added to your tablet!
Here, you can:

 View all monsters currently in your center.
 Check their treatment progress at a glance.
 See which tasks are left to complete for each one.

This makes managing your daily care routine clearer and more satisfying than ever!

🛠️ New Tools & Visuals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/6cb4ce7bf46a955b4bbd57694bdd3347a5cb4347.gif

To support all these new treatment levels, we’ve added a bunch of new tools and effects:
Extractors, dryers, extinguishers, upgraded bandages, and more, all with unique particles and visual feedback to make healing even more fun!

🐞 Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where monsters could teleport from the first floor to the ground floor unexpectedly.
 Resolved a bug where players could select an item while carrying a cardboard box, causing inconsistent behavior.
 Fixed an issue where paintings placed near stairwell walls could get stuck and become unremovable


Psst… hey! 🐾
If you’d like to help out the kind devs (well… we think we’re kind), leaving a little review really helps us a ton!
And don’t hesitate to stop by and say hi on our Discord, we love hearing from you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/5ab554b21a5edd50858023b675ba8c52bd56f9fd.png

Monster hugs to all of you! 💚👾

notes.title: 🔮 Update 0.5 is live, and it’s a big one!
notes.notes:
This update brings life and personality to your hospital like never before. Monsters now behave differently based on their archetype, interact with the environment, and even respond to your commands. Let’s take a look! 👇

[hr][/hr]
Monster Care 0.5 – Changelog Highlights

✨ Shiny Monsters



Rare color variants with glowing effects are here so: Shiny hunting is officially on.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/9251054a5121c4559ce8ab6209362a6e0a366e89.gif"]



🎮 Monster PC System



Store, retrieve, and manage your monsters using a new PC Station!


Only one monster can be active at a time, swap them in or out as needed.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/8f141ad7d1f0a3fecf520933ebdce59fa9539f84.gif"]



🌟 Monster Archetypes Are Here! Monsters now have unique behaviors based on their type:



Healers restore nearby monsters' health.


Cleaners eat poop.


Playful monsters spread joy with hearts and jumps.


Aggressive ones can hurt others when angry.


Plus: Neutral types just chill.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/cbd5990db0f914eba829fe8e89be3977286a2b1a.gif"]



🌳 Environment Interactions



Monsters can now play in water zones, roll around in sandboxes, or poop near trees.


Monsters can sit on chairs and beds.




🧼 Cleanliness Matters



Dirt and poop now reduce happiness over time so keep your center clean!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/aa46e6c658edb9ab014abf5a74620285ee4a2dfa.gif"]



🖐️ Teach & Command Your Monsters



Hold F to open the command wheel and unlock new behaviors over time:


Follow/unfollow, Jump, Monster sounds, Dead pose, and even a Special Dance at higher levels!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/b146e54b8a0751192f3ddd7c847421f3be7f5494.gif"]



🔔 Multiple Welcome Desks



You can now buy and move several welcome desks around your hospital.


Organize your space more efficiently and handle more monsters at once!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/922658325e359ce9202ac79bd2cf7dcc699d04d8.gif"]



🐛 Bug Fixes:


Fixed an issue where the Welcome Desk wouldn't reset properly at the start of a new day if a monster was present.



Fixed a bug where paintings placed on walls became irremovable after the center was upgraded.


Fixed an issue where monster positions could be saved incorrectly when quitting the game.


Added missing localization for selling stations.


Fixed collider issues with the Recovery Station.


Added missing localization to the End of Day recap screen.


Fixed a bug where giving food to a monster would transfer the entire carried stack instead of a single item.


Fixed an issue where small monsters couldn’t be easily returned to clients.


Improved employee pathfinding to reduce instances of them getting stuck when trying to reach a station.



[hr][/hr]

From the Devs  
0.5 is all about giving your monsters more personality, and this is just the beginning!  
Thanks for playing and helping the game grow. If you’re having fun, a little Steam review means the world to us! 💖

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.notes:
Big Update 0.4 is here!
This is our biggest one yet, packed with key improvements to storage, staff behavior, and save management. Let’s break it down!

Monster Care 0.4 – Core Systems & Quality of Life

Inventory & Storage Overhaul
• Items now stack! Up to 99 per shelf slot and 5 per inventory slot.
• Resource usage is now more intuitive.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/e0a8c02c27d68e7c9f66922d1b59ed91a451e6aa.gif

New Employee Behavior
• Employees now require healing resources and will ask you when they run out.
• Restock shelves or hand them the item directly to keep treatments running smoothly.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/bd128790e111da965409b4e2dd9f30167e91e643.gif

No More Money Deadlocks
• Sell used items at the second-hand shop to earn some cash back.
• Customers now pick up monsters after a few days, even if not fully healed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/445dc8ab17b29a68ab51f3850c95c763c2074b53.png

Broom Upgrade
• The broom now has its own quick-access slot, just press "B" to clean up anytime!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/fb3d582b229fb01e2f4d4dc40138b3c1c200193e.png

Multiple Save Slots
• Create, load or delete up to 4 save files.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/35af82b8e98901aacf795e4a5849b15c6add9a76.png

Bug Fixes & Polish
• Fixed collision issues (stairs, garden wall, cashier stuck bugs).
• Sick monsters are no longer placed in upper-floor beds.
• Fixed color issues in the center and onboarding zones.
• Hatching particles no longer get stuck.
• Hat placement corrected on some monsters.
• Improved Russian localization.
• Reputation bug fixed for monsters in beds.
• Fixed furniture placement issues (paintings, frames).

Psst, a little message from the devs:
If you can drop a quick review on Steam, it really helps make the game more visible. Thank you so much for your support! 💖

We can’t wait to show you what’s coming next!

notes.title: Update 0.3.10
notes.notes:
New update 0.3.10 is live! 
We’ve added more ways to personalize your gameplay, improved how you care for your monsters, and, of course, kicked a few more bugs to the curb :broom:

Gameplay & Features

- Added new fences with barn doors, allowing employees and players to enter enclosures without monsters escaping.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/5c0fc8d9b5826c6bd22c79b34d14a3bc54635778.gif
- Monsters can now arrive with multiple issues at once, like being both burned and dirty.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/0d587d8e74e61ef95170ff5b3cc77cc294da771e.png
- Employees can now take care of KO monsters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/dceeeeb4be7f50136ec89382c27582a553a2f24e.gif

New Settings Options

- You can now rebind controls for both gamepad and keyboard/mouse.
- Added new Gameplay Options:
-- Invert camera controls
-- Keep the game running in the background
- Under Graphics Settings, you can now:
- Set a framerate limit
- Toggle VSync
- Hide the interface

Bug Fixes

- Fixed localization issues
- Fixed bugs with gamepad navigation in the Settings and Help Menu
- Removed barriers to allow access around the garden to pick up lost objects
- Fixed an issue with the UI appearing unexpectedly on Hatchers
